After a rare three-week wait, Apple has finally rolled out iOS 27 beta 5 today, bringing new icon designs for several apps including Siri and Safari.

iOS 27 Beta 5 Redesigns App Icons

iOS 27 is getting closer to its official release, expected to launch next month.

This beta 5 includes a number of user-visible changes, paving the way for the final version.

Several built-in apps have been given new icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see some of the new icons in the image above; other apps have also received minor updates.

Since the first beta, iOS 27 has been gradually refining its icon design, as Apple continues to polish the Liquid Glass aesthetic introduced last year.

Since iOS 27 beta testing began, apps such as Maps, Photos and Wallet have gradually received new icons. However, the changes in beta 5 show that Apple has not yet finished its icon adjustments for iOS 27.

What are your thoughts on the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Feel free to share your views in the comments section.
